item.title: Every Artist With 100 or More Billboard Hot 100 Hits
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the provided article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to "Chart Chasers", the podcast where we dive into the world of music charts and explore the milestones that make an artist's career. Today, we're talking about the Billboard Hot 100, the flagship songs chart that ranks the hottest tracks in the US.
[Soft music transitions]
Host: Debuting a song on the Billboard Hot 100 is a big deal, and earning even one entry requires a combination of popularity, audience demand, and timing. The chart takes into account US streaming activity, radio airplay, and sales data. But did you know that over 8,000 artists have earned at least one Hot 100 entry since the chart launched in 1958? And only 23 acts have reached the elite 100-hit milestone.
[Short music break]
Host: Elvis Presley was the first artist to reach 100 career entries, back in 1975. But he's been surpassed by some big names over the years. Today, Drake leads all artists with an impressive 402 total Hot 100 entries. He's the only act in history to reach 400 songs, and he's still going strong.
[Soft music continues]
Host: But who's next? We've seen some new artists join the 100-hit club in recent years, like YoungBoy Never Broke Again, Lil Uzi Vert, and Travis Scott in 2023. And just last year, J. Cole and Ariana Grande joined the club. But there are some artists who are close to reaching the milestone, like Gunna, Lil Durk, and Young Thug, who are all just a few entries away.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode of "Chart Chasers". Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you next time when we explore more music chart milestones.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
